name: AI pull requests
question: Are coding agents shipping code in public?
metric: Public GitHub pull requests clearly labelled as coming from coding agents, latest full month
solvedIf: Coding agents open most pull requests
trendLabel: Public GitHub pull requests from identifiable coding agents, per month.
caution: This undercounts AI work. Most agent-written code is opened under a person's account, so it looks human here. Only accounts and branch names that identify an agent are counted.
It also counts opening, not merging or quality. Codex is matched by its default branch name, so some of those may be people, and a pull request can be automated without any AI.
rule: More agents when more agent pull requests are opened than in the same month a year before.

analysis.title: Which agents
analysis.intro: These are 4.7% of all public pull requests, against 6.8% a year earlier.

scoreReason: 4.7% of public pull requests clearly come from agents, and most agent work is hidden.
